answer: Sponsorship here is a liability that compounds. A newcomer may trade only once an established juniper locks ember behind it, and a juniper backing its m-th live key locks 10m ember. Each epoch the pulse picks one key per juniper at random and reruns its last job. A single forged result forfeits every ember that juniper has locked. A lone newcomer's juniper locks 10 ember. An operator that sponsors 100 clones itself locks 50,500 ember, all lost on one bad pulse, or it must bribe 100 unrelated junipers to each risk their own stake.
